typewriter.use: Top-of-frame kicker / topic label in caps.
typewriter.position: centred, baseline y≈60 (shot 1 origin x≈650; shot 2 x≈700)
typewriter.reveal: 1 character per shown frame (≈20 chars/s), no cursor, no fade per char
typewriter.replace: A new typewriter line types over the old one at the same origin; the old line disappears with the scene blur

wordFadeHeadline.use: Narrated sentence fragment, synced word by word to the voice.
wordFadeHeadline.font: headline (Playfair Display Italic 400, ~52 px); emphasis words Playfair Display Italic 900
wordFadeHeadline.layout: Whole line is laid out at its final position from the first word; words appear in place (no reflow, no slide).
wordFadeHeadline.reveal: each word: opacity 0 -> pale (#B9B2A8) on its first shown frame, then pale -> ink over 2-3 frames

highlighter.use: Behind emphasis words and table rows.
highlighter.shape: Yellow #F1D01A band, rough marker ends (slightly irregular top/bottom edge), extends ~8 px past the text, height ~0.85 of the cap+x height
highlighter.reveal: clip-path wipe left -> right over 3-4 frames, ease-out; stays on
highlighter.multiWord: extends word by word in sync with narration (biggest f727-729, then bill f732-733)

maskRiseText.use: Huge key numbers and key words ($40 TRILLION, $117,000, THE INTEREST, FUTURE, PAST).
maskRiseText.reveal: each glyph slides up from below a baseline clip mask (translateY 100% -> 0) over 3-4 frames, ease-out; stagger 1 frame per glyph
maskRiseText.exit: blur + fade out over 3 frames when replaced

sourceLine.behaviour: fades in ~3 frames when the scene's first statistic appears; swaps text per scene

dimText.use: Push the previous statement back before the payoff line.
dimText.behaviour: opacity/colour to ~45% over 6 frames (f861-867); strike strokes go to dark red
